source.title: [P1] Approve procurement for prototype bench and five-channel capture qualification
source.body:
## Goal

Qualify the **exact components for procurement**, then obtain **explicit owner purchase approval** for the minimal items needed to commission the **one-sensor feasibility bench** and physically qualify the five independent capture inputs in Issue #5. Procurement qualification does not require a complete delivered-order grand total; component purchase eligibility is separate from physical-use qualification. Do **not** interpret creation of this issue, or merge of PR #37, as permission to buy, fabricate, solder, connect, flash, energize, or test hardware.

## Sources and retained decisions

- [Issue #3](https://github.com/whatobiplays/screen-latency-tool/issues/3) Stage-A prototype design / sourcing plan (closed as design-stage only).
- [Issue #5](https://github.com/whatobiplays/screen-latency-tool/issues/5) physical capture acceptance (open). Software candidate [PR #37](https://github.com/whatobiplays/screen-latency-tool/pull/37) was merged at `d15eee370f07cd32fc48f1489f2a25df83d41a70` under an owner-authorized **software-only integration exception**.
- `docs/bench/PROTOTYPE-PROCUREMENT-READINESS.md` (BENCH-003, 2026-11-06): 31-MPN one-sensor basket, 24 REVIEW / 7 HOLD, modeled $138.89 BOM / $138.94 Strategy A; excludes shipping, tax, fabrication, some harnessing, instruments, mechanics. **REVIEW is not purchase authorization**.
- `hardware/prototype/BOM.csv` and source KiCad symbol properties remain source-of-truth for exact MPNs and quantities. Keep lifecycle facts and rejected alternates.
- `docs/bench/PROTOTYPE-BENCH-GUIDE.md` / `docs/bench/PROTOTYPE-POWER-LOAD-BUDGET.md`: owner-selected `KA3005PE+` current-limited bench supply, but purchase/receipt unverified; `INITIAL_CURRENT_LIMIT = UNSET / PENDING REVIEW`. Stage-B first-power and S2/S3/S4 release **not granted**. Keep original XT30U J2 design; no unapproved mating substitution, no substitute USB breakout or OPA320.

## Work / acceptance criteria

- [ ] **Inventory reconciliation:** Record what the owner already owns, has ordered, and has physically received (Teensy 4.1 revision/PSRAM, KA3005PE+, DMM/probes/leads, oscilloscope, logic analyzer / five-channel independent edge counter, suitable electrical pulse generator, USB bus analyzer, sensor PCB/components, power and USB parts). Do not infer absence from the ledger.
- [ ] **Separate purchase baskets:** (A) minimal protected one-sensor/USB/power feasibility kit and (B) incremental Issue #5 five-input electrical capture qualification tools/connections. Defer full five-sensor production PCB/BOM; distinguish USB T0 analyzer borrow/rental from purchase.
- [ ] **Exact-component procurement qualification:** Verify manufacturer identity/lifecycle where obtainable, specifications, package/interface, intended circuit role, supplier **exact MPN**, quantity/MOQ, a credible source and stock/orderability evidence, and quality/traceability risks. Record observed prices and U.S. shipping/tax/duty information when available, but **do not block component procurement clearance on an exact delivered total, a destination-specific checkout quote, or formal lot/date certificate when these are not necessary to establish part authenticity and fit**. At order time, reconfirm the exact listing, quantity, and shipping feasibility. Never silently substitute a mismatched connector or clone.
- [ ] **Disposition the seven original procurement HOLDs:** `OPA320AIDBVR`, `RC0603FR-07100RL`, `MF-R050`, `Pololu 5383`, exact AMASS `XT30U-F.G.Y` and `XT30U-M.G.Y`, and `USB-uBM-uBF-V1A`. For each, determine whether the exact part is **PROCUREMENT-CLEARED** for the specified prototype/evaluation purpose, or retain a specific **PROCUREMENT HOLD** for a concrete identity, authentic sourcing, unsound specifications/fit, or other pre-purchase risk. **Record separate ASSEMBLY/POWER-USE HOLDs** for actual unverified harness, fault/current/thermal coordination, VIN/VUSB isolation, USB signal and other physical safety gates. A component may be acquired for later inspection and evaluation while the assembled power or USB path remains blocked. Neither a listing nor a supplier stock counter alone proves technical fit or qualified use.
- [ ] **Instrument scope:** Preserve owner-selected Korad KA3005PE+; make a measurement-equipment/fixture needs matrix for independent edges on all five channels, both polarities, `R_sensor_max` and 2x bursts, skew resolution, cold cycles, and USB-bus T0 correlation. Identify existing equipment first, then exact needed procurement/borrowing and realistic costs.
- [ ] **Purchase-decision packet:** identify exact cleared MPNs, quantities, where to buy, observed unit prices where available, and any independent support/PCB/instrument dependencies. Retain the **$1,100 preferred / approximately $1,300 flexible** budget as a spending guardrail, **not a requirement to calculate an exact total before qualifying components**. Shipping, tax, duties, delivery, and final cart amounts may remain unknown until checkout; record this without disguising a planning estimate as a quote. Keep **PROCUREMENT-CLEARED**, **ASSEMBLY/POWER-USE HOLD**, **PRICE OBSERVED**, **DELIVERABILITY UNVERIFIED**, and **OWNER APPROVED** distinct.
- [ ] Obtain **explicit owner authorization for each proposed purchase basket** and any PCB fabrication. No checkout or order placement without that authorization. Do not assume a spending ceiling is authorization.
- [ ] Preserve separate **Stage-B** approvals after receipt: component inspection, protected input, current/fault limits, VIN/VUSB isolation, unpowered wiring, and separately authorized first power. Physical qualifications for Issues #4/#5 remain `NOT_RUN / UNVERIFIED` until actually performed.

## Scope exclusions / failure modes

No production five-sensor assembly; no arbitrary live hardware actions; no forced substitution of `XT30U-F.G.Y`/`XT30U-M.G.Y` with similar-name `DFT-` through-hole versions; no reliance on unknown-lifecycle alone as a disqualifier for the approved **one-sensor-only** exception; no unapproved numerical current-limit guess; no order without owner permission or without verifying that the exact selected SKU can actually be purchased and shipped at ordering time. Do not treat date-stamped listing prices as binding order totals.

## Initial 2026-11-12 sourcing observations (not yet checkout-qualified)

- Exact `OPA320AIDBVR` shown with single-piece cut tape through [DigiKey](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/texas-instruments/OPA320AIDBVR/2747411) and [Mouser](https://www.mouser.com/en/ProductDetail/Texas-Instruments/OPA320AIDBVR); quantity/delivery must be confirmed at checkout.
- Exact `RC0603FR-07100RL` listed at [DigiKey](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/yageo/RC0603FR-07100RL/726888), earlier out of stock.
- Exact `Pololu 5383` permits backorders but no reliably established on-hand ship date on manufacturer page.
- Exact eLabBay `USB-uBM-uBF-V1A` product page describes an unassembled kit but does not expose a selected-variant landed quote.
- DigiKey search returns **KaiFeng `DFT-XT30U-...`**, **not** exact AMASS cable-solder `XT30U-*.G.Y`; cannot auto-substitute.
- Korad `KA3005PE+` found at DigiKey $134.24 listed, but owner inventory/receipt and purchase authority unknown.

Prepare the exact-component procurement clearance packet and ask the owner to approve the chosen orderable parts/quantities. **Do not wait for an exact grand total to complete technical procurement qualification.** No order is authorized by issue creation or this scope clarification.

## 2026-11-13 owner clarification: component clearance before exact cost

The owner directed that **exact landed-price/grand-total completion must not block qualifying or clearing prototype components for procurement**. The primary acceptance is a reasoned per-component procurement verdict tied to exact identity, technical fit and credible supply. Price/delivery uncertainty must be labeled and checked when ordering, not disguised as a technical incompatibility. The physical protection path (including MF-R050 coordination, regulator-specific OVP and 3.3 V faults, XT30U harness ratings, VIN/VUSB separation and USB behavior) must remain independently held until its own protection case and Stage-B releases. No authorization to purchase, fabricate, energize, or test follows from this clarification.

The next sourcing/protection slice is #40: reconcile all seven Basket A HOLDs with exact evidence and owner-directed disposition, while keeping Basket B instrumentation and PCB fabrication independent and unapproved. This issue remains OPEN for explicit owner inventory reconciliation, delivered basket quotes, separate purchase/PCB decisions, and Stage-B boundaries. No purchase, fabrication, physical work or Gate 1/Issues #4/#5 qualification has been authorized by the merge.

comments.text:
**Owner clarification, 2026-11-13:** Procurement clearance is about part identity, functionality, authentic/credible sourceability and a documented risk boundary; an exact delivered basket total is **not** a precondition. Any conflicting language below is superseded by this clarification and the updated Issue #38 acceptance criteria. Purchase authorization and all Stage-B safety gates remain separate.

## Issue #38 — 2026-11-13 procurement closeout checkpoint (no approval inferred)

**Status:** Owner decision required; keep Issue #38 open. Issue #40 is closed, and its documentation PR #41 is merged. BENCH-003 §3.2 remains the authoritative exact-MPN matrix: **31 purchasable codes / 37 required units; 24 REVIEW ($120.19 observed) + seven HOLD ($18.37 mixed current/historical planning) = $138.56 component-only planning**. No line has a destination-verified landed quote or owner purchase approval. No part, PCB, equipment, or Stage-B test is authorized by this comment.

**Known owner inventory vs unknown:** Issue #3's 2026-11-01 comment reports a basic DMM and basic soldering equipment; model, leads, fit and current usability remain unconfirmed. The exact Teensy 4.1/U4 regulator revision, Korad KA3005PE+ purchase/receipt, probes/leads, capture/reference instruments, sensor PCB, hardware consumables and other purchases remain UNKNOWN. Do not silently order Fluke 855705 leads if owned leads meet the requirement.

**Proposed procurement staging, not a design or approval change:**
1. Reconcile owner inventory, then quote the missing **Basket A** exact-MPN lines. The 24 REVIEW items are eligible for purchase review, not automatically orderable. Assess the seven HOLD lines individually (OPA320AIDBVR; RC0603FR-07100RL; MF-R050; Pololu 5383; exact AMASS XT30U-F.G.Y and XT30U-M.G.Y; eLabGuy USB-uBM-uBF-V1A). A lower-cost unpowered procurement tranche may be offered for explicit owner authorization while unqualified installed power pathways stay disabled. Do not represent a subset as a complete one-sensor kit.
2. Keep **Basket B** instrumentation conditional: first verify existing equipment and characterize the actual comparator-edge R_sensor_max, pulse width/spacing/bursts, two polarities, independent reference, five-channel skew, and USB HID T0 correlation. Borrow/rent before purchasing specialized equipment; no instrument candidate yet qualifies all required capabilities.
3. Keep **PCB fabrication/assembly** separate and on HOLD until a released KiCad-compatible upload or Gerber/drill package, physical-fit/assembly method and exact fabrication quote exist. $17.05 for 3 OSH Park bare boards is a planning allowance, not an order.

**Source-reconciliation follow-up:** Independent supplier-page inspection found the exact DigiKey Yageo RC0603FR-07100RL / 311-100HRCT-ND listing reporting stock, contrary to the prior dated zero-stock snapshot. This is an availability lead **only**: confirm exact live cart quantity, traceability, U.S. delivery and landed cost; do not mark DELIVERABLE on a search snapshot. Mouser's exact TI OPA320AIDBVR offer was also visible ($2.90 / 94 stock in the referenced current supplier listing), still subject to quote and exact lot/delivery terms. Generic XT30U-F/M catalog offers must not be substituted for exact .G.Y identity without manufacturer/supplier confirmation; Pololu 5383 allows backorders without a verified ship date; eLabBay's unassembled USB kit has no confirmed selected-variant checkout quote. No supplier inquiry or checkout was performed here.

**Non-waivable next-stage protection boundary:** BENCH-004 records a plausible 3.3 V branch short (TLV75533P typical 355 mA) below MF-R050's 40 °C hold (410 mA), and a conditional GST18U05-P1J overvoltage window reaching above the TLV755P input absolute maximum. Source/branch fault containment, exact U4 revision, XT30 harness ratings/polarity/strain relief, VIN/VUSB physical separation and a defensible supply-time/energy bound remain open. **INITIAL_CURRENT_LIMIT=UNSET.** Ordering a component does not qualify a protection path; S0/S1/S2/S3/S4 require their own later releases. No power, USB connection, flashing, assembly or physical testing is authorized.

**Owner decisions required before procurement closeout:** confirm owned/ordered/received items (especially Teensy, Korad supply, DMM leads, instruments, PCB); choose whether to procure exact low-cost power parts now for later evaluation while leaving Stage-B safety HOLDs in place; and separately approve/defer Basket B and PCB fabrication. Present **exact supplier SKU × quantity**, technical procurement qualification, credible purchase source, and observed unit price when known. The owner may approve a basket or subset with an explicit spend ceiling while final shipping/tax remains unknown; verify final exact SKU and U.S. shipping feasibility at checkout. **No exact grand total or destination-specific landed quote is required to clear a component for procurement.** Close #38 only after its authorized scope is completed or explicitly transferred.

## 2026-11-13 — Exact-component procurement qualification screen (after owner cost-gate correction)

**Decision boundary:** An exact delivered basket total is **not** an admission gate for component procurement clearance. This is a **read-only engineering/source assessment**, not an order, an independent-reviewed documentation PR, or a hardware test. No checkout, purchase approval, fabrication approval, assembly, connection, flashing, energization, or current-limit selection is implied. BENCH-003 §3.2 still holds its pre-correction statuses until a reviewed documentation correction lands.

| Original HOLD | Proposed **procurement** disposition | Direct evidence and exact role | Retained **assembly/use or fulfillment** gate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **TI OPA320AIDBVR**, qty 1 | **CLEAR for owner evaluation-purchase review** | TI lists exact OPA320AIDBVR ACTIVE, DBV five-pin SOT-23; exact authorized Mouser **595-OPA320AIDBVR** cut-tape MOQ 1 and DigiKey **296-29480-1-ND** alternate. 3.3 V TIA role is within published supply range. [TI](https://www.ti.com/product/OPA320/part-details/OPA320AIDBVR), [Mouser](https://www.mouser.com/en/ProductDetail/Texas-Instruments/OPA320AIDBVR?qs=g5raLcSarObYYXG7KaVGxQ%3D%3D). | Confirm exact marking/pin-1/footprint, received package and optical analog performance after receipt. Supplier-page quantities vary with time; verify at cart. |
| **Yageo RC0603FR-07100RL**, qty 1 | **CLEAR for owner evaluation-purchase review** | Exact Yageo 100 Ω, ±1%, 0603, 0.1 W resistor; DigiKey exact **311-100HRCT-ND** cut-tape MOQ 1, Newark **98K7334** alternate. [Yageo](https://yageogroup.com/component-documentation/download/specsheet/RC0603FR-07100RL), [DigiKey](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/yageo/RC0603FR-07100RL/726888). | Verify live cart stock and exact item; conflicting/stale supplier stock snapshots do not change fit. Confirm received package and layout before assembly. |
| **Bourns MF-R050**, qty 1 | **CLEAR ONLY as a bench evaluation component; NOT cleared as a sufficient system protector** | Exact radial PTC available as DigiKey **MF-R050-ND**; maker 0.5 A hold/1.0 A trip at 23 °C. [DigiKey](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/bourns-inc/MF-R050/259965), [Bourns datasheet](https://www.bourns.com/docs/product-datasheets/mf-r.pdf). | **Hard safety HOLD:** no guaranteed downstream 3.3 V branch short clearance, thermal energy bound or adapter OVP coordination. BENCH-004 §§2.1,4,7.1 unchanged; no installed-path/first-power release. |
| **Pololu 5383**, qty 1 | **CLEAR ONLY as a bench evaluation module; NOT cleared as a complete 5 V protective path** | Manufacturer direct exact #5383, active/preferred, 4–60 V startup and reverse-current-blocking ideal-diode function; manufacturer accepts backorders but does not promise a ship date. [Pololu](https://www.pololu.com/product/5383). | **Hard safety HOLD:** no adjustable current limit, downstream OVP, VIN/VUSB isolation or short clearance. Actual startup/voltage-drop and wire/terminal safety remain unqualified. Confirm supply/ship status before ordering. |
| **AMASS XT30U-F.G.Y**, qty 1 | **CLEAR for evaluation-purchase review; verify U.S. ship-to acceptance at order** | Comet seller explicitly identifies exact AMASS cable-solder female manufacturer code **XT30U-F.G.Y**, order code **5521133**. [Comet](https://store.comet.bg/en/Catalogue/Product/5521133/). | Seller stock is in Bulgaria. Comet Terms §3.2 explicitly support shipments abroad, creating a credible international sourcing path, but U.S.-specific checkout acceptance remains unverified. Do not substitute similarly named base-code or KaiFeng DFT parts. **Hard harness-use HOLD:** gauge, solder cup and joint, polarity, strain relief, retention, contact/fault energy still unqualified. |
| **AMASS XT30U-M.G.Y**, qty 1 | **CLEAR for evaluation-purchase review; verify U.S. ship-to acceptance at order** | Comet explicitly identifies exact AMASS cable-solder male manufacturer code **XT30U-M.G.Y**, order code **5521134**. [Comet](https://store.comet.bg/en/Catalogue/Product/5521134/). | Comet Terms §3.2 support shipments abroad; U.S.-specific checkout acceptance remains unverified and is checked when ordering, not as an exact-cost gate. No replacement with different code; female is source, male is load. Hardware fit/polarity/rating remains Stage-B. |
| **eLabBay/eLabGuy USB-uBM-uBF-V1A**, qty 1 | **CLEAR as an unassembled exact-model USB breakout kit for owner evaluation-purchase review** | Brand storefront identifies exact male/female Micro-B pass-through PCB, both Micro-B connectors, headers, screw terminal and jumper; VCC path is **open by default** and intentionally configurable. [eLabBay](https://elabbay.myshopify.com/products/usb-bm-bf-v1a-micro-usb2-0-type-b-male-to-micro-usb2-0-type-b-female-pass-through-breakout-board). | Maker listing does **not** establish selected-kit cart availability/ship date. Assembly, pin map, D+/D− continuity and integrity, VCC CLOSED, shield-to-GND OPEN, physical VIN/VUSB cut and no USB-data breadboard remain mandatory later checks. |

**Preliminary screening result:** All seven original HOLD lines have credible exact-item sources and role-specific specifications for **owner review of evaluation-only purchase**, without waiting for an exact grand total. For the **two XT30U halves**, Comet's [Terms §3.2](https://store.comet.bg/en/Terms/) explicitly cover shipments abroad, while actual U.S. checkout acceptance and costs are unverified and must be checked only before placing an order. This is **procurement eligibility**, not guaranteed fulfillment, OWNER APPROVED or *protected-power-use* qualification. Missing safety information is not relabeled as PASS merely because evaluation-component purchase is permissible.

**Documentation correction required:** Revise BENCH-003 §3.2 and §14 to add separate per-line procurement eligibility versus assembly/energized-use/fulfillment gates and to eliminate exact landed-total as a prerequisite to procurement clearance. Retain all prior safety analysis, supplier snapshots, MPN reconciliation, unapproved states and Stage-B limits. Validate with make check, independent full-diff local review, then direct ChatGPT source review before PR merge. No other issue acceptance is waived. Issue #38 stays open until the owner approves exact purchase scope, with Basket B and PCB decisions separately resolved or explicitly tracked.
